title: DiMT-Net: Digital Platforms, Disinformation and Political Polarization - code and data
description: Code and derived data for a cross-national analysis of digital-platform intensity, disinformation and political polarization (V-Dem v16, Digital Society Project and World Bank indicators, 2000-2024, up to 179 countries). Includes the panel econometric pipeline (two-way fixed effects with country-specific trends, lagged, first-difference, placebo and leave-one-region-out robustness) and DiMT-Net (Disinformation Multi-Task Temporal Network), a two-layer GRU encoder with multi-task heads for three polarization outcomes and three auxiliary disinformation outcomes, benchmarked against GRU, Random Forest, MLP, histogram gradient boosting and Ridge on an untouched 2022-2024 temporal test set.
